mechanism_claims.claim_text: GsMTx-4 directly blocks cation-selective stretch-activated channels in outside-out adult rat astrocyte patches.
mechanism_claims.limitations: The paper supports functional block and kinetic affinity, but does not resolve whether block occurs by shifting channel activation tension or by blocking permeation.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: GsMTx-4 reduces swelling-activated currents in astrocytes and specifically blocks inward cation-selective swelling current in rabbit CHF-model ventricular myocytes.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: GsMTx-4 in mammalian cell current assays
mechanism_claims.limitations: The swelling-current effects are mammalian electrophysiology/cell-volume findings, not bacterial membrane antimicrobial assays.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The source explicitly leaves the molecular action mode unresolved: GsMTx-4 can act on closed channels, but the paper does not decide between activation-curve shift and permeation-path block.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Do not promote lipid-bilayer partition or antimicrobial membrane mechanism from later/database rows to this primary paper.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Current paper supports ion-channel block and volume-current physiology; database/later-reference antimicrobial mechanism statements are not adjudicated as primary-source findings for this DOI.
